name: Arpita
heroMessage:
Today marks the beginning of Chapter 19 — and the world is infinitely more radiant because you are in it. From your graceful smile to that enchanting look in your red and black sari, every moment with you is magic.

May this 19th year bring you boundless happiness, thrilling milestones, and every dream your heart cherishes.

Here's to celebrating you on your special day and always.
memoriesSubtitle: A visual timeline of moments that mean everything to me
footerText: Handcrafted with care exclusively for Arpita's 19th Birthday • 13th November
